origin: authored defaults; not measurements of an external design

density.calm_only_when: the request asks for a minimal, calm, quiet or restrained page, or scripts/design-lock.mjs init --density calm; calm restores 64 to 128 px sections, a flat canvas and no glow

work_surfaces.applies_to: screens people work in repeatedly (admin consoles, analytics views, settings, internal tools) rather than pages read once
work_surfaces.first_viewport: the working content and primary controls; no hero headline, tagline or illustration block above them
work_surfaces.pixel_art: a small accent at most, never the primary visual anchor
work_surfaces.lock: these screens lock the graphite house style, not this palette

fit: User direction and existing tokens win; preserve readable content at 320px.
